cases.hypothesis: Causative make constructions introduce a resulting quality, effect, or belief.
positive_cues: made or makes follows a subject and awaits a complement
Examples describe making games special, flaws meaningful, food tastier, or a belief justified
Rhetorical and evaluative clauses use make to connect cause with outcome
exclusion_cues: Not a domain-specific topic such as games, lyrics, cooking, or hacking
Not simple repetition of the word make without a resulting state or interpretation

cases.hypothesis: French-language text and French lexical continuations, including formatted contact details.
positive_cues: French grammar, vocabulary, accents, and dialogue appear throughout
Phone numbers and Grenoble postal addresses are embedded in French prose
Fragments ch and b continue French words such as chuchota and battrons
exclusion_cues: Not English-only narrative or an English lexical completion
Numbers alone are insufficient without the surrounding French context

cases.hypothesis: Telephone contact numbers continue in standard North American formatting.
positive_cues: Every context follows call at, call, or telephone line language
Parenthesized three-digit area codes and hyphenated digits are visible
The active fragments are immediately before additional phone-number digits
exclusion_cues: Not postal codes, dates, prices, or arbitrary numeric lists
Email and business prose provide contact context rather than a semantic topic

cases.hypothesis: Slow or gradual pacing is used as a descriptive or evaluative motif.
positive_cues: The word slow appears in video, panic, rail, and dialogue-pacing descriptions
Contexts evoke contemplative movement, creeping anxiety, delay, or understated timing
Slow functions as an adjective or adverb describing temporal pace
exclusion_cues: Not fast, sudden, or acceleration language
Not a single fixed subject; the shared cue is slowness or gradual progression

cases.hypothesis: Negated ability or impossibility is expressed with cannot, can't, or can never.
positive_cues: Administration cannot fix the policy problem
We can never enter heaven and you cannot do the proposed measurement
The printer is implied to be unusable without a compatible driver
exclusion_cues: Not affirmative ability or permission expressed by can
Not arbitrary negation lacking an inability or impossibility consequence
